title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-at5f: rule_id sentinel ambiguity in std_ext FragmentReceiver
description:
## Bug

**File:** `rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs:1091`

Commit `df4676fb` changed `std_ext::FragmentReceiver.rule_id` from `Option<u8>` to `u8`, using `0` as the sentinel value for "uninitialized" (see `new()` at line 1114).

However, SCHC rule ID 0 is a valid value — SCHC rules are numbered starting from 0. The sentinel check at line 1187:
```rust
if self.rule_id == 0 {
    self.rule_id = frag.rule_id;
}
```
cannot distinguish "no fragment received yet" from "first fragment had rule_id == 0". If the true rule_id is 0, the receiver can silently mix fragments from different datagrams because the sentinel never transitions to a "locked" state.

## Comparison

The production `FragmentReceiver` at line 723 correctly uses `rule_id: Option<u8>` with `None` as the sentinel. The `std_ext` version should match this pattern.

## Fix

Revert `rule_id` to `Option<u8>` in the `std_ext::FragmentReceiver` struct with `None` default, matching the production implementation at line 723.
